format: WSDC Jack and Jill contests at a Registry Event (scoring)

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: All WSDC Jack and Jill contests must use the WSDC-approved Callback system for preliminaries and the Relative Placement scoring system for finals, calculated by a computerized system (3.4.9.b).

requirement: Results of an event that declares WSDC may be approved or published only through a scoring method verified for WSDC. None exists: wsdc_relative_placement is unavailable with no authoritative algorithm source, and the Studio callback tally is not the WSDC Callback system. Declared WSDC events are blocked at approve and publish.
enforcement_point: Server actions approveRoundResultAction and publishRoundResultAction call guardRoundResultsForSanction before the database transition and refuse when blocked; the round results page and publicationControls mirror the refusal. App layer only: the database RPCs do not check the declaration (follow-up, needs SQL).

tests.name: OD-01 guard: every body x method x declaration combination

interpretation_notes: Relative Placement is defined on the WSDC website, not in the supplied rules: UNRESOLVED until independently verified. The WSDC-approved Callback standard (Appendix) and computerized-system requirements are not verified against the Studio callback tally. effective_from is the file-name revision date (Jan 17 2026), not a stated effective date. Not verified_compliant. The 3.4.9.f exception never applies to Jack and Jill contests.
applicable_event_versions: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
